name: Runner Extras - Relation Own-Namespace Dependency Twin
brief: Issue #5224: a bundle table naming a table in a TableRelation or CalcFormula resolves it to the same table whether or not a modify(...) tableextension touches the writing table.
description: Runner-specific: the runner builds a table nobody modifies from BC's compiled metadata and one a modify(...) extension touches from its AL source, two routes that must answer alike. The BC half (which table the name means) is corpus codeunit 69217 'Test Relation Own NS Dep'; this suite pins only that the two routes agree. The writing tables sit in Microsoft.Foundation.Shipping, so the name means Base Application's table of the own namespace, while a using brings in a bundle table of the same name.
